subject: POC kickoff & hands-on session — access, prompts, routing & load checks
messages:
From: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@boxco.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@boxco.com
Date: 2026-11-30T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: POC kickoff + hands-on working session — Box & Co

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is keen to move to a hands-on PoC. We'd like a 3.5–4 hour working session that includes: prompt review, routing behavior for our multi-tenant flows, and a short load check to validate throughput under realistic prompt mixes.

Two date options that work for us:
- Tue Dec 8, 09:00–13:00 PT
- Wed Dec 9, 10:00–14:00 PT

We have ~6 people planning to attend onsite in SF and ~8 joining remotely. A few security items up front: Box & Co needs confirmation on visitor pass process, whether the session will be recorded (they prefer no cloud recordings), and an allowlist for network endpoints for any in-office devices.

Can Redwood host this hybrid session onsite at your office, or do you recommend fully virtual? If onsite, what room capacity/AV do you have and how do we handle badge pre-registration?

Happy to share a short list of prompts and a spreadsheet with expected concurrency if that helps with planning — I can send the list once we lock a date.

Thanks,
Anna
Head of Data & Integrations
Box & Co

Attachments: none

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@boxco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-30T11:01:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff + hands-on working session — Box & Co

Hi Anna — great to hear. We'd love to run this as a hybrid session. Dec 8, 09:00–13:00 PT works on our side — pencil it for now and we'll firm it after logistics.

Proposed agenda (attach below):
- 09:00–09:20: introductions & success criteria
- 09:20–10:30: prompt workshop (prompt engineering and edge cases)
- 10:30–10:45: break
- 10:45–11:45: routing & policy validation (multi-tenant routing scenarios)
- 11:45–12:30: load check (30–45 minute incremental ramp)
- 12:30–13:00: next steps & action items

A few logistics/questions so we can lock the room:
- Onsite headcount: please send the full list of attendee names and company IDs for visitor passes (we require names + photo ID for pre-registration).
- Recording: we default to no cloud recording for customer sessions; we can do local recording by Redwood engineers for notes if you sign off. Confirm whether Box & Co allows that.
- AV & screen sharing: our G14 room has HDMI + AirPlay + an RTMP-capable capture box (we can stream to a private meeting room). If you have a preference for how remote folks join (Zoom vs Google Meet), let us know.
- Network allowlist: attaching a sample allowlist (Network_Allowlist.csv). If you need static IPs for the short test window, we can provide a short-lived egress range.

I'll loop Hannah from facilities and Marissa (customer success) to handle room & visitor flows, and Dylan to own the load plan and prompt test harness.

Attached: POC_Agenda_v2.pdf, Network_Allowlist.csv

Best,
Soojin
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-30T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: reserve room & prep load plan — Box & Co PoC (Dec 8)

Internal only — do not forward this message to customer.

Marissa / Dylan — Anna from Box & Co wants Dec 8 09:00–13:00 PT for a hybrid hands-on PoC. Please action these items:

Marissa:
- Can you reserve Room G14 (capacity 12, AV: HDMI, AirPlay, capture box) for 08:30–13:30 to allow setup and teardown?
- Start visitor pass workflow: we need a list of 6 names + ally company IDs by EOD 12/2 to pre-register. Use visitor_pass_template.pdf as the form.
- Confirm whether Facilities can disable cloud recording at the room capture box; we must honor customer request to avoid cloud retention.

Dylan:
- Build a short load check: start with 2 concurrent users and ramp to ~25 req/s over 30 minutes using the exact prompt mix Anna will provide. Plan for a 30–45 minute window during which we'll monitor p99 latency and token cost.
- Prepare a routing validation plan: 6 routing scenarios (tenant A -> model v1, tenant B -> fallback quantized variant, priority override cases). Add an isolated GPU pool for the test window to avoid noisy neighbors.

Hannah:
- Please confirm whether we can get RTMP stream disabled for remote recording and that local capture remains available to Redwood engineers only. Also confirm badge pickup procedure for visitors and whether security needs to be looped in.

I will update Anna once we have confirmations and will collect attendee list.

Thanks,
Soojin

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01T08:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Internal: reserve room & prep load plan — Box & Co PoC (Dec 8)

All set on our side for Dec 8. Quick updates:
- Room G14 is reserved 08:30–13:30. AV kit confirmed (HDMI + AirPlay + capture box).
- Facilities can set the capture box to local-only storage; cloud stream/archival will be disabled for the session. We'll require a signed consent from Box & Co if any internal engineer records locally.
- Visitor pass flow: please send names + company IDs. We'll have passes printed and front-desk notified (pick-up with photo ID).
- I'll attach visitor_pass_template.pdf for Anna to complete.

Dylan: please send me the GPU pool id you want reserved so I can block it with Infra for that window.

Marissa
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: visitor_pass_template.pdf

From: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@boxco.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@boxco.com
Date: 2026-12-01T15:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff + hands-on working session — Box & Co

Thanks, Soojin — Dec 8, 09:00–13:00 PT works for us.

Confirmed attendee list for onsite (names + company IDs):
- Miguel Santos — ID A71234
- Priya Nair — ID A71235
- Helen Park — ID A71236
- Omar Ruiz — ID A71237
- Tara Chen — ID A71238
- Anna Lopez — ID A71239

Security note from our security team (security@boxco.com): Box & Co does NOT allow cloud storage of meeting recordings or raw request logs. Local recording by Redwood engineers is acceptable if Box & Co signs the recording consent form (please send). We can share the prompt list and expected concurrency CSV by EOD tomorrow (I'll attach in a follow-up).

Also: we prefer Zoom for remote attendees (company policy). Please send the dial-in/meeting link once it's set and confirm firewall allowlist before the session (we'll test connectivity earlier that morning).

Look forward to it.
Anna
Head of Data & Integrations, Box & Co
